name: Summit AZ - Tempe Page Optimization Brief 2026-07-21
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-07-21

# Summary
Optimization brief for `/general-plumbing-services-in-tempe/` (20,105 impressions, average position 23). Diagnosis: intent mismatch. The page is framed as general plumbing, but its biggest demand is emergency and 24-hour queries ("emergency plumber tempe", 2,629 impressions at #26).

# Key points
- Near-miss terms at positions 12 to 18: emergency plumbing services tempe, 24 hour residential plumbing services in tempe, plumbing company, 24 hour plumber near me, plumber tempe and similar.
- Fix list: retitle for emergency and 24/7, intent-based H2s, direct-answer intro, FAQ plus FAQPage schema, internal links with Tempe anchors, authority work in parallel.
- Ready-to-paste copy: SEO title, meta, H1, intro, six H2 sections, FAQ. Focus keyphrase: emergency plumber tempe.

# Caution
The brief's 24/7, "24-hour" and after-hours wording was written in July. Later work removed 24/7 copy (2026-09-09) and rewrote after-hours claims on emergency pages because the business keeps Monday to Saturday 8 to 5 hours (see [Summit AZ - SEO Progress Report 2026-09-24](lib:brain-summit-az-seo-progress-report-2026-09-24)). Do not reuse this copy without checking current hours and Scott's approval. The 2026-09-23 report still lists "emergency plumber tempe" as the top non-brand query with zero clicks, answered by the wrong page.
